title: Benino NDE 3749
content: I was four years old and had the flu. Because of the severity of my coughing fits, the pediatrician had prescribed a discontinued medication: Tussifargan. Shortly after lunch, my mother gave me this cough medicine and put me to bed where I whiled away the time looking at comic strips. Then I felt as though I was suffocating, because my tongue had swelled up and was blocking my airway. My nasal passages were also closed up due to the flu. I fainted on the bed. After an indefinable moment of time, I found myself outside of my body, and I saw my body lying on the bed. I rose in the air always keeping my eye on my body. Then everything turned black. I found myself in a tunnel. The sides of the tunnel were brown, grey and black and the colors were all mixed up together. I didn't perceive sound, heat, hunger, feelings, weight, memories, anxiety, and emotions. I was all sight. The time I remained in the tunnel is hard to say, but it seemed like several weeks. At the end of the tunnel, there was a small light. Suddenly I was outside the tunnel, in blackness, maybe (I don't remember this detail exactly) there was a kind of brown pavement. In front of the light was a streak of black. I arrived in front of the light and the streak became the shape of a man, it didn't have any depth, it seemed to be two dimensional, looking like a black and white comic strip character. I wasn't even a half a meter away when the figure lifted its hand and reached for my left shoulder. I watched the black hand that approached and saw my shoulder (it was the only time that I glimpsed a portion of my body during the whole experience). The hand wasn't able to touch me because I was suddenly pulled from behind and whisked away. The great light became a point; I went back through the tunnel and then darkness. In reality, I had remained unconscious for about ten minutes, during which time they brought me to the hospital where I vomited up my lunch. The peristaltic movement brought down the swelling of my tongue and massaged my heart. I stayed in the hospital for a few days and they said I didn't have any brain damage. I forgot the experience but I dreamt about it often. When I was thirteen years old, I watched a TV documentary about near death experiences and remembered the whole event. I felt such strong emotion that I fainted and then was traumatized for weeks. I continually dreamt about the experience, which was different from what I had watched on TV, but still there were similarities.

arrival.other_being_detail: A streak of black became the shape of a man, two-dimensional like a black-and-white comic strip character; it lifted its hand and reached toward the experiencer's left shoulder but could not touch because the experiencer was pulled away.

environment.environment_other_detail: Tunnel sides were brown, grey, and black mixed together; outside the tunnel was blackness and possibly a kind of brown pavement.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Flu with severe coughing fits; adverse reaction to prescribed cough medicine (tongue swelling, airway obstruction) leading to fainting/unconsciousness.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encounter with a two-dimensional man-shaped black figure near the light; sudden pulling/whisking away from behind.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE (seeing body) followed by blackness, tunnel with a small light, emergence into blackness near the light and figure, then rapid return back through tunnel and darkness.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perception described as lacking sound/heat/hunger/weight/memories/anxiety/emotions: 'I was all sight.' The encountered figure appeared two-dimensional like a black-and-white comic strip character. Possible 'brown pavement' in the blackness outside the tunnel.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I didn't perceive sound, heat, hunger, feelings, weight, memories, anxiety, and emotions. I was all sight.”
